description: Parked with measurements. Of 177 rest views decoding one 172-byte line, 120 (68%) are consumed by a self-recursive step, 35 (20%) by another function's first match, 17 (10%) escape in {:ok, v, rest}, 5 (3%) are unused. Removing the 88% needs a new transport shape (binary + bit position as two lanes), a demand arm for 'only matched', a distinct executable per layout, interpreter parity, and a view built on escape. Estimated worth: 5-7% of decode (views plus their collection); a minor collection makes a dead view cheaper still. Re-measure after fz-sc8.183.5 and its siblings and the collector work before building. Evidence and predictions: proposal page fz-sc8.183.5.html (workspace root); spike files in scratchpad b183-5 and b183-6.
title: A binary walk passes its position instead of a rest view
